attchmntText: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "STALLION INDIA FLUOROCHEMICALS LIMITED Q2 & H1 FY27 FINANCIAL RESULTS & STRATEGIC UPDATE".
voiceSummary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited filed a press release regarding its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial results. The company reported total income of 13,937.33 lakh rupees for Q2 FY27, a 31.79 percent year-on-year increase. H1 FY27 total income rose 22.07 percent to 26,404.90 lakh rupees. Operating EBITDA before ESOP provision was 1,583.54 lakh rupees in Q2 and 4,110.32 lakh rupees in H1. Operating PAT before ESOP provision stood at 1,196.21 lakh rupees in Q2 and 3,052.78 lakh rupees in H1. The company noted a non-cash ESOP provision of 950.92 lakh rupees for H1 FY27. Additionally, the Khalapur High-Purity Helium Facility commenced operations in September 2026. The firm entered a strategic partnership with Sharjah Oxygen Company L.L.C. SP for liquid helium sourcing.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended on 30th September, 2026 issued by Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited, Monitoring Agency, for the quarter ended on 30th September, 2026 with respect to the utilisation of proceeds of the Rights Issue of the company.
voiceSummary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30th September 2026 with the NSE and BSE. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from the Rights Issue of Rs. 363.93 crore. Infomerics Valuation and Rating Limited is the Monitoring Agency. The report notes that the agency cannot ascertain the range of deviation from the objects due to incomplete contract details with EPC contractor Pansen Engineering India Pvt Ltd. Total payments of Rs. 78.00 crore were made to the contractor in Q2FY27. These are advance payments. The agency verified that cumulative payments remain within the estimated payable amount of Rs. 269.76 crore. However, the agency could not map these payments to individual invoices. Issue-related expenses of Rs. 36.00 crore are fully utilized. Land acquisition costs are Rs. 10.21 crore utilized. Construction of the manufacturing facility has Rs. 232.08 crore utilized. Unutilized funds total Rs. 85.64 crore.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report issued by CARE Ratings Limited, Monitoring Agency, for the quarter ended on 30th September, 2026 with respect to the utilisation of proceeds of the Initial Public offer (IPO) of the company.
voiceSummary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, with CARE Ratings Limited. The report notes a deviation in fund utilization. Management utilized 0.40 crore from own funds parked in a fixed deposit at ICICI Bank, which the monitoring agency classified as a deviation because it monitors only IPO proceeds. There is a delay in utilizing proceeds for the Mambattu project, with 0.40 crore remaining unutilized as of September 30, 2026. The company extended timelines for capital expenditure under objects two and three via a special resolution dated June 3, 2026. Previous material deviations regarding issue expenses and land purchase were regularized through the same special resolution. The monitoring agency observed commingling of funds and a classification difference of 3.99 crore for share issue expenses. The total IPO size was 160.73 crore.

attchmntText: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the unaudited financial results of the Company for the Quarter & Half Year ended 30th September, 2026
voiceSummary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited published its Unaudited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026 in the Mumbai Edition of Free Press Journal and Navshakti on 14th November 2026. The results were approved by the Board of Directors at its meeting held on 13th November 2026. NCDEX Limited also published its Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the Quarter and Half Year ended 30th September 2026. These results were reviewed by the Audit Committee on 12th November 2026 and approved by the Board of Directors on 13th November 2026. State Bank of India issued an e-auction sale notice for immovable properties of borrowers Shamshad Mubarak Khan and Shabina Shamshad Khan. The auction is scheduled for 14th December 2026 between 11:00 am and 04:00 pm. The reserve price is Rs. 1,91,00,000 with an Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 19,10,000.

attchmntText: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited approved its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 13, 2026. Revenue from operations for the half year was 2,74,775 lakhs, with a profit before tax of 3,05,342 lakhs. Profit for the period stood at 2,10,186 lakhs. Basic earnings per share was 181. The company received net IPO proceeds of 14,474.87 lakhs. It granted 15,86,505 equity share options to employees. Total assets as at September 30, 2026, were 77,330.34 lakhs. Net worth was 71,115.15 lakhs. Cash and cash equivalents were 20,390.85 lakhs. Statutory auditors issued a Limited Review Report confirming no material misstatements.
